description: This file defines a custom exception class `ClientHasNoStaffException` used in the Fineract project to indicate that a specific client has no associated staff. It extends an abstract exception class and provides a constructor that generates an error message based on a client ID.

classes.name: ClientHasNoStaffException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a client has no staff assigned.

methods.name: ClientHasNoStaffException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a specific error message based on the client ID.
